These small fixtures preserve public element names/structure observed in the six
HTML documents supplied as `Pupu.zip`. They are manually reduced reproductions,
not copies of the complete saved pages. Supplier identifiers, buyer/account data,
conversation text, scripts, trackers, tokens and unrelated page content are omitted.
Inline scripts in these fixtures are explicit test doubles written for the tests.

- `captured-mic-store.html`: repeated `J-open-tm` actions, visual placeholders,
  storefront header and a separate inquiry form (434096135 / 220146650).
- `captured-alibaba.html`: `icbu-alitalk` storefront/toolbar actions and the
  `send-box-container` composer with `send-textarea` / `send-tool-button`
  (390833943 / 407597383 and the later `Алибаба кнопка.txt`). The `gray` class
  intentionally remains on an enabled button, reproducing the later capture.
  No outgoing-message markup was present in the captures.
- `captured-1688-store.html`: `pcV2WangWang` and a visible middleware security
  iframe (457454315). The challenge URL deliberately has no captured parameters.
- `captured-1688-shell.html`: `layout-iframe` outer shell (407487735). Its inner
  document/editor was not present in the supplied source. It is not fabricated here.

Existing `chat.html` and `store.html` are synthetic generic workflow fixtures.
